```typescript
// Retrieve details for a specific Gumroad product by its ID.
async function getProductDetails(productId: string) {
  try {
    const product = await client.getById({ id: productId });
    console.log(`Product Name: ${product.name}`);
    return product;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to retrieve product details:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Obtain authentication tokens for a Gumroad resource.
async function authenticateResource(aboutToken: string) {
  try {
    const authTokens = await client.getAssetsAboutByAboutToken({ aboutToken: aboutToken });
    console.log(`Authentication Tokens: ${JSON.stringify(authTokens)}`);
    return authTokens;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to retrieve authentication tokens:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```
